create_optimizer_instance: create a FairseqOptimizer instance with a config object to manage model training optimization
set_learning_rate: set the learning rate across all param groups using the set_lr method on FairseqOptimizer
clip_gradient_norm: clip the gradient norm of all optimizer parameters to a specified max_norm value
perform_optimization_step: perform a single optimization step with optional scale factor and parameter groups on FairseqOptimizer
load_optimizer_state: load an optimizer state dict with optional overrides to resume training from a checkpoint
